text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit U-turn movements on Dunmurray Boulevard, between Eaglestone Road and Gablehurst Crescent. Prohibiting U-turns will provide a safer environment for all road users along this section of Dunmurray Boulevard, which is located adjacent to Pauline Johnson Junior Public School, Stephen Leacock Collegiate Institute school grounds, and Stephen Leacock Park.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited northbound and eastbound U-turn movements at all times on Dunmurray Boulevard, between Eaglestone Road and Gablehurst Crescent.
